episodes.title: The Capital Stack: Who's Actually Lending in Late 2026
episodes.headline: Half of Commercial Real Estate Loans Now Come From Outside the Banks
episodes.summary: The capital stack, explained layer by layer on one Jersey City deal, plus who is writing the checks in late 2026, what the Fed's September hike means for floating-rate borrowers, and why rescue capital is having its moment.
episodes.interview_line: The capital stack is being re-priced from the top down: senior lenders are sizing on debt yield at today's rates, leaving gaps that pref and mezz are filling, while alternative lenders, often financed by banks, take share.
